content.user_title: Build Cloudflare K2 Streams With Current Documentation
content.value_statement: Cloudflare K2 setup and troubleshooting require current API details, configuration rules, and delivery semantics. This skill directs your assistant to relevant documentation before providing guidance.
actual_capabilities: Directs stream setup guidance to current prerequisites, setup sequences, and API examples.
Guides configuration research for inputs, authentication, CORS, and retention.
Directs HTTP and Worker production guidance to request syntax, encoding, errors, and retries.
Guides subscription consumption research for leases, acknowledgements, retries, and errors.
Requires checking current limits and published pricing before answering capacity or cost questions.
Routes SQL transformation questions to the basin skill and task processing questions to Queues documentation.
limitations: Contains documentation guidance only, with no bundled scripts or executable integration.
Requires documentation retrieval access for current API details and examples.
Some referenced pages may be unpublished; proposed pull request pages may differ from released behavior.
Does not guarantee published pricing, service availability, or successful deployment.

use_cases.title: Plan Worker Event Production
use_cases.description: Review current K2 setup and production documentation before connecting a Worker to a durable event stream.

use_cases.title: Review Retention and Capacity
use_cases.description: Check stream retention settings, inputs, authentication, and current limits before planning operational capacity.

use_cases.title: Troubleshoot Subscription Delivery
use_cases.description: Consult subscription documentation to investigate lease handling, acknowledgements, retries, and consumer errors.

prompt_templates.title: Understand K2
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain Cloudflare K2 streams and subscriptions using the current overview and concepts documentation. Identify any unpublished details.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up a Stream
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through creating a K2 stream for [application]. Check current prerequisites, input authentication, CORS, and retention documentation first.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Production Errors
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate this K2 production error: [redacted error]. Check current HTTP or Worker documentation for request syntax, encoding, and retry behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Review Consumer Capacity
prompt_templates.prompt: Review K2 subscription design for [workload]. Verify current leases, acknowledgements, retries, retention, and limits. Separate published facts from proposed documentation.

output_examples.input: Which documentation should I consult before producing K2 records from a Worker?

output_examples.input: What should I check when investigating K2 consumer retries?
output: Consult Consume records for lease, acknowledgement, retry, and error behavior.
Use Concepts to confirm the current delivery model.
Check Limits before attributing failures to capacity.

output_examples.input: Should I use this skill for SQL transformations into R2 Iceberg tables?
output_examples.output: The skill directs SQL transformation and delivery to R2 Iceberg tables to the basin skill.

best_practices: Retrieve task-specific current documentation before relying on API examples or setup instructions.
Distinguish published documentation from proposed pull request pages and identify unavailable pricing or availability details.
Share redacted error messages and configuration context when requesting troubleshooting guidance.
anti_patterns: Assuming this documentation skill automatically provisions streams or deploys Workers.
Treating proposed documentation as a guarantee of released service behavior.
Quoting remembered limits or pricing without checking current published sources.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It guides an assistant to current Cloudflare K2 documentation for stream setup, configuration, production, consumption, and troubleshooting.

faq.question: Does it create streams automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill contains documentation instructions, not bundled provisioning scripts or an executable client.

faq.question: Can it help with HTTP and Worker producers?
faq.answer: Yes. It directs the assistant to production documentation for current request syntax, Worker bindings, encoding, errors, and retries.

faq.question: Can it troubleshoot subscriptions?
faq.answer: It directs troubleshooting to consumption documentation covering leases, acknowledgements, retries, and errors.

faq.question: What happens when public documentation is unavailable?
faq.answer: The skill allows proposed pages from Cloudflare documentation pull request 33858 while it remains open. Proposed pages may change before publication.

faq.question: Does it provide fixed pricing or capacity values?
faq.answer: No. It requires checking current limits and published pricing, and stating when requested pricing or availability details are unpublished.
